title: Palimpsest instrument measurements
description: Only Palimpsest's own current instrument measurements, with a result, source receipt, freshness state and limitation attached.

items.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Network layer elevated in the latest board synthesis
items.summary: Palimpsest measurement. The merged board read remains a measure of cross-signal movement, not a verdict about any single cause.
items.content_text:
ITEM TYPE: PALIMPSEST MEASUREMENT

Result: Upstream board reports: single layer elevated: network. 33 of 33 configured sources report; 31 are live. Health qualifiers: 1 degraded, 1 stale. The board-wide e-value is 25.929; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20.

Limit: A merged e-value measures evidence against no change; it does not identify a common cause for co-movement.

Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/board-alarm-latest.json

items.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 13 of 15 configured signals are reporting to the event board

items.content_text:
ITEM TYPE: PALIMPSEST MEASUREMENT

Result: 13 signals are reporting out of 15 configured signals in the current event-flags reading.

Limit: Each detector is calibrated to its own history, so equal event values do not imply equal wall-clock rarity.

Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/event-flags-latest.json

items.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Coverage changes confound 1 current signal

ITEM TYPE: PALIMPSEST MEASUREMENT

Limit: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred.

Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/coverage-guard-latest.json

items.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Forecast bands covered 84.4% of 1,404 scored readings

ITEM TYPE: PALIMPSEST MEASUREMENT

Limit: Calibration describes aggregate historical coverage and does not guarantee that any one next reading falls inside its band.

Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/forecast-ledger-latest.json

items.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 0 cross-layer relationships are confirmed across 8 eligible tests
